findings.title: Brittle source identity comparison
findings.message: Strict equality of the whole source dict fails if the SDK manifest adds any extra source key (such as a timestamp or dirty details), and it raises an uninformative error. It also leaves the partial output in place.
findings.suggestion: Compare the specific keys `clean` and `commit` and include both values in the error message.

findings.title: Unverified artifacts shipped in bundle
findings.message: The README claims the ZIP check directories contain the exact signed ZIP payloads, and the bundle manifest hashes only the zips. The extracted trees and the extracted SDK are left in the output directory unhashed, so the bundle's integrity claim covers only part of the output. The built binaries (app-N) are also left in the output but are not listed in files.
findings.suggestion: Remove the intermediate binaries or include all shipped artifacts in the checksum list.

finding.title: Manifest field mislabeled
finding.message: The loop variable `module` is a Path inside the extracted SDK or the consumer dir, both under `out`, so this works. However the check passes `cwd=module` for the Document Starter, which is a generated app whose go.mod replace directives are verified only by check_origin. The record name 'module' also holds a path, not a module, which is misleading in the manifest.
finding.suggestion: Name the field 'path' to avoid confusion.
